name: Critic agent (M2) — 8-case golden set (Phase-4 skeleton)
description: Phase-4 skeleton golden set per critic.spec.md §7. Each case pins a (rubric, candidate output, verdict) triple drawn from real Tier-1 agent outputs. The full 200-case set with human-labeled verdicts (judge_agreement_v_human ≥ 0.85 inter-rater) ships in Phase 5 once the rubric-per-locale split is finalized.
